outcome.technical: audit-lookup.py compose_phase_brief: the shown set and the owed list now derive from one set - every task with a commit that no filed phase return answers at that commit (_fr.answered_entries keyed on (id, commit)). Tasks a filed return answers are listed once in 'Re-review scope' with the return's path and are not given sections; fix tasks and tasks closed after the round are shown; owed is drawn from shown, so every owed task has a section. With no filed return nothing is known reviewed and everything is shown, as a first round always did. 'Reviewed' is read off the filed return's task entries rather than ancestry of its head, because the filing verb writes one entry per owed task bound to its commit and refuses a return missing one, while an ancestor test misreads a rewritten branch.
